user_intent: Establish Developer Mode restrictions, prohibit unapproved edits to .py files, mandate fact-based reports, enforce platform isolation (Naukri vs LinkedIn), and introduce surgical profile updates.
why_user_made_such_thinking: The user recognizes that AI coding agents tend to hallucinate changes, self-approve flawed fixes, and hardcode user-specific data into general-purpose code. To build a robust, scalable system, the user established rigid boundaries upfront.
why_user_performed_this_way: The user used imperative, unambiguous language ('you are not allowed to edit a single file unles you make the report and i approved it manually... in no capacity allowed to self-approve'). This eliminates any ambiguity regarding AI autonomy vs human oversight.
user_reaction_and_satisfaction: Initial baseline setting. Expectant of rigorous compliance.
did_ai_actually_understand: Partially initially, but fully internalized when Guardrail P1 and ProfileContext were codified. The AI realized that 'developer mode' means 'read-only analysis until formal review'.
was_work_done_exactly_as_asked: Yes. Implemented verify_codebase_purity() and strict gatekeeping protocol.
evolutionary_takeaways: Never touch production code without presenting a formal plan and awaiting approval. Core code must be 100% generic.
